bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
test -S "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock" || exit 62
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT 1 FROM link_button_posts LIMIT 0;" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 63
count="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM link_button_posts WHERE content='リンク機能テスト用の本文' AND status='draft' AND share_code IS NOT NULL;" 2>/dev/null)" || exit 64
test "$count" -ge 1 || exit 65
python3 -B - "$root" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"scripts"))
try:
 from userbot_resident_ipc import SOCKET_PATH
except Exception:sys.exit(66)
if not SOCKET_PATH.is_socket():sys.exit(67)
if SOCKET_PATH!=root/"deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock":sys.exit(68)
PY
echo LINK_INLINE_READ_ONLY_PREREQS=PASS
